headline: Roto Pumps submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
summary: Roto Pumps Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This routine corporate filing completes the post-AGM compliance process for the company. Indian retail shareholders can review the final voting outcomes for all resolutions passed during the meeting. Such procedural disclosures have no direct impact on stock price movement.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact.
